stage: CPU proposal only; no model implementation or GPU request issued
hypothesis: Patient-independent bag learning on OOF predicted occurrences can remove document-background HPO associations while retaining original patient attribution.

data.nested_generators: three train32 -> disjoint16; exact manifest and full-document membership checks
data.scope: Allowed atomic HPO only; preserve NIL/non-HPO associations unchanged in proposed filter.

prior_negative_baselines.marked_patient_CE: sequence run_neural_relation.py 09ae97d2: 4ep, 5114 gold-entity patient-concept pairs, Score .617746 vs same-pool rules .656999; up to3 concatenated contexts, max384, class-weighted CE. Not an untried method.
prior_negative_baselines.aggregate_tree: ontology aggregate_relation.py: OOF patient-concept reduced hand features, 45189 rows/1181 positives; fold0 replacement .669171/.672308 and union .704175 below .710359 base; fold1 same controls all lower. Not a new claim of feature aggregation.

minimal_future_control.model: Existing general BiomedBERT; each occurrence encoded separately with HPO name, highlighted exact phenotype and one shared marker type for any provided patient mention. No required local patient marker.
minimal_future_control.bag: Document+atomic HPO; one occurrence logit per span; max across all occurrence logits; binary bag loss, no relabeling each occurrence as positive. No new candidate supplementation.
minimal_future_control.optimization_proposal: One fixed3epoch endpoint; unweighted BCE because bag counts are near balanced. Exact LR/batching/token retention require a frozen implementation plan before any run.
minimal_future_control.inference_proposal: p>=.5 retains existing concept relations; predicted negative bag removes that concept from all original patients. Entities and assignments for retained concepts and NIL remain unchanged. No relation additions.
minimal_future_control.comparison: Same frozen CRF+Sap rules pool/base on outerfold0, no originaldev. Later GLiNER augmentation is a separate variable.
minimal_future_control.cost_estimate: 3004 occurrence contexts x3epochs; approximately2-4 GPU minutes including load/validation, not measured. No new base download.

limitations: Patient-independent labels cannot repair75 wrong-patient FP when the concept belongs to some other specified patient.
319/394 current OOF rule FP are negative doc-HPO, but this is error characterization, not an achievable model Score.
417/783 positive bags lack any provided patient mention start in all +/-220 windows; absence cannot be a rejection rule.
47 positive bags contain no exact gold positive occurrence; document-level labels remain weak.
Proposed control changes candidate distribution, target granularity and multi-instance pooling relative to old CE; if useful, later matched ablations would be needed for causal attribution.
176 bounded Qwen linking remains current execution priority; this document does not authorize GPU training.
